```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
NCAA <- read.csv("~/Downloads/NCAA Tourney Data(Sheet1).csv")
```

```{r}
NCAA$Seed.Group <- ifelse(NCAA$NCAA.Tournament.Seed %in% c(1, 2),
                          "1 or 2 Seeds",
                          ifelse(NCAA$NCAA.Tournament.Seed %in% c(15, 16),
                                 "15 or 16 Seeds", NA))

NCAA_filtered <- subset(NCAA, !is.na(Seed.Group))


```
```{r}
ggplot(NCAA_filtered, aes(x = Seed.Group,
                          y = Average.Starter.Height)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Average Starter Height: High vs. Low Seeds",
       x = "NCAA Tournament Seed",
       y = "Average Starter Height (inches)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)

NCAA_filtered %>%
  group_by(Seed.Group) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Average.Starter.Height, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(Average.Starter.Height, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q1 = quantile(Average.Starter.Height, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(Average.Starter.Height, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    Minimum = min(Average.Starter.Height, na.rm = TRUE),
    Maximum = max(Average.Starter.Height, na.rm = TRUE),
    Standard_Deviation = sd(Average.Starter.Height, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR = IQR(Average.Starter.Height, na.rm = TRUE),
    Count = n()
  )
```
```{r}
ggplot(NCAA_filtered, aes(x = Seed.Group,
                          y = Average.Weight.of.Starting.Lineup)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Average Starter Weight: High vs. Low Seeds",
       x = "NCAA Tournament Seed",
       y = "Average Starter Weight (lbs)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
NCAA_filtered %>%
  group_by(Seed.Group) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Average.Weight.of.Starting.Lineup, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(Average.Weight.of.Starting.Lineup, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q1 = quantile(Average.Weight.of.Starting.Lineup, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(Average.Weight.of.Starting.Lineup, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    Minimum = min(Average.Weight.of.Starting.Lineup, na.rm = TRUE),
    Maximum = max(Average.Weight.of.Starting.Lineup, na.rm = TRUE),
    Standard_Deviation = sd(Average.Weight.of.Starting.Lineup, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR = IQR(Average.Weight.of.Starting.Lineup, na.rm = TRUE),
    Count = sum(!is.na(Average.Weight.of.Starting.Lineup))
  )
```
